name: Tortilla Chips
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets as corn is naturally low FODMAP. Choose brands without high-FODMAP seasonings like onion or garlic powder.
preparationTips: Read ingredient labels carefully - avoid chips with onion or garlic powder
Choose plain salted varieties over flavored options
Stick to recommended serving sizes to avoid excess fat intake
Pair with low-FODMAP dips rather than high-FODMAP options
nutritionalHighlights: Provides small amounts of magnesium and phosphorus
